Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Security hardening: Production-ready configuration

## Security Improvements

### 1. CORS Security
- Implemented origin whitelist validation
- Default localhost origins for development
- Production origins configurable via ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var
- Blocks unauthorized cross-origin requests

### 2. Rate Limiting
- General rate limiting: 100 requests/15min per IP (configurable)
- Strict rate limiting for route generation: 20 requests/15min per IP
- Prevents DoS attacks and API abuse
- Created separate middleware/rateLimiter.js module
- Fixed circular dependency between app.js and routes.js

### 3. Request Size Limits
- Body size limited to 10MB to prevent memory exhaustion attacks
- Prevents large payload DoS attacks

### 4. Input Validation
- Enhanced validation for route generation endpoint:
  - Prompt required (string, 5-500 chars)
  - Type checking for all inputs
- Existing validation verified in places endpoints

### 5. Environment Configuration
- Added security environment variables to .env.example:
  - ALLOWED_ORIGINS (CORS whitelist)
  - RATE_LIMIT_MAX (general rate limit)
  - RATE_LIMIT_ROUTES (route generation limit)

### 6. Production Deployment Checklist
- Created comprehensive DEPLOYMENT-CHECKLIST.md
- Covers security, monitoring, testing, and rollback procedures
- OWASP Top 10 compliance verification
- Cost monitoring guidelines

## Files Changed
- backend/src/app.js - Security middleware configuration
- backend/src/routes/routes.js - Input validation + rate limiter import
- backend/src/middleware/rateLimiter.js - NEW: Centralized rate limiting
- backend/.env.example - Security environment variables
- backend/package.json - Added express-rate-limit dependency
- backend/DEPLOYMENT-CHECKLIST.md - NEW: Production deployment guide

✅ Security changes validated
